<div class="card-body">
'''I'm On The Leader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">先頭機は任せろ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：「アタック・ラン」を行っている宇宙戦闘機を1機、目標として選ぶ。運命数を引き、デス・スター上にあるTIEの1機につき、1を加える。合計の値＞目標の回避値なら、宇宙戦闘機はロストする。2：このターンの終了時まで、任意の1機の宇宙戦闘機の武器運命数にそれぞれ1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Im-On-The-Leader-SWCA-67723.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いにおけるデス・スターの防衛戦で、ダース・ベイダーはブラック2とブラック3を従え、3機編隊の先頭にたって攻撃を行った。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' I'm On The Leader.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. Target one starfighter making an Attack Run. Draw destiny and add 1 for each TIE on the Death Star. If the total exceeds the target's maneuver, the starfighter is lost. Until the end of this turn, add 1 to each weapon destiny of any one starfighter.

'''Lore:'''
In the Death Star defense at the Battle of Yavin, Darth Vader took Black 2 and Black 3 and attacked at the head of a three-ship formation.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title is 先頭機は任せろ.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I'm On The Leader]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
